eyebrow: Watsi · Colombia board trip, Clinica Noel, Medellín · 20 Oct 2026 · Scripted FAQ 4 of 5
title: Sonam:
title_q: “What Do You Wish More People Knew They Could Do on Watsi?”
headline: You don't have to give alone: anybody can start a Watsi campaign for any reason, and 100% of what it raises goes to patient care.
story: Sonam names what you expect her to say (donate to a patient), then turns it: there's so much more you can do together. Start your own Watsi campaign for anything: a birthday, a marathon, a wedding. Real examples: Chris climbed Kilimanjaro, and a donor's 5K in Brooklyn. It still feels like Watsi: messages, gifts, and 100% of it goes to patient care.

It ends with friends and family celebrating together, on real celebration footage, and it can be even more fun to do with your own people. Loops: L1 “If not donating, then what?” opens at 0:00 and closes on the campaign idea. L2 “Does it still go to patients?” closes on “100% of it. We don't take a cut.”
do: Question on screen at 0:00, at least 5 s.
Show watsi.org/campaigns when she says campaign.
Show the Chris hikes Kilimanjaro page, then a licensed Kilimanjaro shot.
Use the NYC run footage Sonam shared for the 5K and the celebrating.
Name super with no box and no sharp edges.
dont: No clinic footage on the celebrating lines.
No unlicensed or invented summit footage.
Never name the CSC hospital. No patient face without a release.
Don't make it about fundraising mechanics or Watsi asking for money.
